description: Start a new append-only hash-chained ledger file (.vrec). Each entry links to the previous one by hash; anyone can later verify the file was not tampered with. Fails if the file already exists (ledgers never overwrite).

path.description: File path for the new ledger, e.g. ./work.vrec

title.description: What this ledger is for (recorded as the genesis entry note)

name: ledger_start
